I don’t have real‑time access to live air‑quality feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact AQI value for Los Angeles at this moment. However, here’s how you can quickly find the most up‑to‑date information:

| Source | What it offers | How to use |
|--------|----------------|------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Current AQI, pollutant breakdown, forecast, and health advice. | Visit <https://www.airnow.gov/> → “Find Air Quality” → type “Los Angeles” → select the nearest monitoring station. |
| **AQICN** (World Air Quality Index) | Global coverage, real‑time AQI, historical data, and mobile app. | Go to <https://aqicn.org/city/los-angeles/>. |
| **Local news outlets** (e.g., LA Times, KABC) | Often report on smog alerts and health advisories. | Check their weather or environment sections. |
| **Mobile apps** (e.g., Plume Labs, BreezoMeter) | Push notifications for smog alerts and health recommendations. | Download the app, enable location services, and set alerts for Los Angeles. |

### Quick Tips for Interpreting the AQI

| AQI Range | Health Impact | Recommended Action |
|-----------|---------------|--------------------|
| 0–50 (Good) | No adverse health effects. | Normal outdoor activities. |
| 51–100 (Moderate) | Unhealthy for sensitive groups (children, elderly, people with respiratory issues). | Reduce prolonged outdoor exertion. |
| 101–150 (Unhealthy) | Everyone may experience health effects; sensitive groups more affected. | Limit outdoor activity, especially strenuous exercise. |
| 151–200 (Very Unhealthy) | Serious health effects. | Avoid outdoor activity; consider indoor air purifiers. |
| 201+ (Hazardous) | Health warnings of emergency conditions. | Stay indoors, keep windows closed, use HEPA filters. |

If you’re planning to be outside or drive around Los Angeles, it’s a good idea to check the AQI a few hours before you head out. Many of the sites above also provide a short‑term forecast (next 12–24 hours) so you can plan accordingly.

Let me know if you’d like help setting up alerts or interpreting specific pollutant levels!
